title: WhatsApp
readOnly: You can see the mappings. Only admins and owners can change them.

list.title: Message templates
list.intro: WhatsApp only allows a message that starts a conversation if it uses a template Meta approved. Create templates in Meta's WhatsApp Manager, then map each message below to its approved template.
list.unmapped: Not mapped to a Meta template
list.rejectedHint: Meta rejected this template. Remove the mapping and map a different template.

warning.called: The "You're called" message has no approved template. WhatsApp guests will get nothing outside the 24 hour reply window.

errors.not_configured: WhatsApp is not set up for this business yet.
errors.unavailable: Meta did not answer. Try again in a moment.

map.title: Map to a Meta template
map.name: Template name in Meta
map.nameHint: Exactly as shown in WhatsApp Manager, for example queue_called.

remove.title: Remove the mapping to {{name}}?
remove.description: This message will not go out on WhatsApp outside the 24 hour reply window until you map another template.

errors.category_mismatch: That category does not match this message. Utility templates carry service messages; marketing templates carry announcements.
errors.permission_denied: Only admins and owners can change mappings.
